input.free_text_description: This system is an authentication platform that serves User, Admin roles. It manages core business objects including api error details, authentication token, user credentials, query user result. The platform provides capabilities for greeting, username password validator, authentication token issuer. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include distributed transactions functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a User, I want to create and manage api error details records, so that I can track and organize api error details data effectively.
As a User, I want to create and manage authentication token records, so that I can track and organize authentication token data effectively.
As a User, I want to create and manage user credentials records, so that I can track and organize user credentials data effectively.
As a User, I want to create and manage query user result records, so that I can track and organize query user result data effectively.
